answer_1.quote: We used the pre-trained language model T5 for generating repetitions because it has performed well in language generation... We evaluated the proposed methods on a dataset we created in Japanese for automatic and human evaluations.
answer_1.outputs: Generated repetition responses (short replies that repeat content words from the previous utterance)

answer_2.quote: The evaluation metrics were ROUGE (RG-1, RG-2, RG-L) and the percentage of outputs containing correct repeated words.

answer_4.quote: We also conducted a human evaluation by comparing three types of response generation methods... The responses were shown to five workers and evaluated on a three-point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Workers evaluated each response on a three-point Likert scale based on several criteria.
